sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The "Community Based Training Scheme" aims to provide training in heavy vehicle driving, shorthand, security services, office soft skills, retail sales, and beauty parlor courses (male & female) to unemployed young men and women belonging to minority communities for self-employment or employment.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Skills & Employment; Sector: Training and Skill Up-gradation

**Detailed Description:** The "Community Based Training Scheme" was launched by the Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka, and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. The scheme aims to provide training in Heavy Vehicle Driving, Short Hand, Security Services, Office Soft Skill, Retail Sales, Beauty Parlor Course (Male and Female) to the unemployed young men and women belonging to minority community for self employment or employment in MNC, BPOs and other activities.
Benefits / Assistance: - The scheme provides training in Heavy Vehicle Driving, Short Hand, Security Services, Office Soft Skill, Retail Sales, and Beauty Parlor Course (Male and Female).

**Application Process:** Step-01: Applicant need to visits the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation [official website](https://kmdconline.karnataka.gov.in/Portal/home). Step-02: Click "Apply Online&quot
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation; Nodal Department: Minorities Welfare Department
**Tags:** Skill Development, Employment, Unemployed, Minority Community
